title: Egyptian Almond Delight
description: A simple dessert recipe featuring the crunch of almonds and the sweetness of nutty flavors. Serve warm or at room temperature.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together almonds and Egyptian spice blend.
In a separate bowl, mix together nutty spread and stir-fry oil.
Arrange the juicy dates on a baking sheet and spread the nutty spread mixture evenly on top.
Sprinkle the almond mixture over the dates.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the almonds are lightly toasted.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
